title: Exploring the relationship between TMT behavioral integration and environmental performance in Pakistani SMEs: a study of green innovation, green dynamic capabilities, and green finance
core_idea: The study investigates how top management team behavioral integration (TMTBI) relates to environmental performance (EP) in Pakistani manufacturing SMEs, testing whether green dynamic capabilities (GDC) and green innovation (GI) mediate that relationship and whether green finance (GF) moderates it. It is framed by upper echelons, resource-based view, and ability–motivation–opportunity theories and uses a survey of 410 SME respondents with structural equation modeling to assess the proposed hypotheses.
tldr: A theory-driven survey study examining the relationship between TMT behavioral integration and environmental performance in Pakistani SMEs, testing mediation by green dynamic capabilities and green innovation and moderation by green finance using SEM.
